title: Fermentation Temperature Stability Alert
dataSources: Fermentation gravity/temperature (`brew:fermentation`), kegerator pours (`kegerator:pour`), wine-cellar climate (`winecellar:reading`).
app: Fermentation sensors (Tilt/iSpindel hydrometer, temperature), kegerator flow meters and scales, and wine-cellar climate sensors via MQTT and Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=brew:fermentation
| eval in_band=if(temp_c>=target_c-1 AND temp_c<=target_c+1,1,0)
| stats latest(temp_c) as temp, latest(target_c) as target, sum(eval(in_band=0)) as out_of_band
| eval drift=round(temp-target,1)
description: Warns when a fermenting batch drifts outside its target temperature band, where off-flavours are born.
value: Yeast produces off-flavours when it gets too warm or cold; a tight temperature alert protects the taste of the whole batch.
implementation: Ingest fermentation-chamber temperature; alert whenever the reading leaves the target band around the set point.
visualization: Time chart of fermentation temperature with a target band overlay.
grandmaExplanation: It warns you if your fermenting beer gets too warm or too cold, which can spoil the flavour.
